SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, TO_CHAR(KEY_2) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM keptrxl WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ILSHPO' AND TRIM(KEY_10) IS NULL GROUP BY KEY_1,KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'ILSH' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, decode(po_no,null,'D','C') as STATUS, key_1 as LEGACY_PO_NO, key_2 as LEGACY_PO_SEQ, nvl(item_no, ' ') as BUYER_ITEM_NO, nvl(currency, ' ') as CURRENCY_CODE, nvl(unit_price, 0) as UNIT_PRICE, nvl(item_qty, 0) as ITEM_QTY, nvl(amt, 0) as ITEM_AMT, nvl(add_date, ' ') as ADD_DATE, nvl(rd_date, ' ') as RD_DATE, nvl(dely_to_location, ' ') as DELY_TO_LOCATION, nvl(purchaser_user_id, ' ') as PURCHASER_USER_ID, nvl(pr_no, ' ') as PR_NO, nvl(req_user_name, ' ') as REQ_USER_NAME, nvl(req_user_dept_name,' ') as REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, nvl(dept_pro_name ,' ') as LEGACY_PR_NO FROM keptrxl, view_po WHERE doc_name = 'ILSHPO' AND key_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND key_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND key_1 = po_no(+) AND key_2 = po_seq(+) AND TRIM(KEY_10) IS NULL
UPDATE keptrxl SET KEY_10 = 'Y', KEY_9 = to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND doc_name = 'ILSHPO' AND TRIM(KEY_10) IS NULL
UPDATE keptrxl SET KEY_10 = 'E', KEY_9 = to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND doc_name = 'ILSHPO' AND TRIM(KEY_10) IS NULL
